claim_scope: The pure Python ZDEX purchase-burn composer accepts leaf and fee-budget verification markers only when their module release IDs and expected guest images match exact owned module releases selected by the ordered route.
failure_modes: a mutated purchase marker names an unselected module release or guest image
a mutated burn marker names an unselected module release or guest image
a mutated fee-budget marker names an unselected tokenomics release or guest image
a valid but foreign module release record is substituted into the route candidate
a release-binding rejection returns economic effects

aaa.reason: The regressions arrange one mutated marker coordinate or one valid foreign release, act through the pure route composer, and assert the exact typed reject code plus an empty effect plan; the replay node pins the unchanged composition root.

reject_is_noop.reason: Every release or image substitution returns a typed route rejection carrying the canonical empty effect plan.

mutations.description: omit purchase and burn marker module-release and expected-image comparisons
accept any same-lane module release supplied by the caller instead of the route-selected release

nonclaims: These are non-authoritative process-local Python verification markers and grant no settlement or publication authority.
Rust marker fields are private and immutable; this packet does not claim a new Rust runtime theorem or a cryptographic receipt proof.
The frozen composition-root replay shows ordinary fixture parity and does not prove general tokenomics or AMM correctness.
This packet does not close public construction, fork inheritance, concurrent mutation, migration, outbox, complete mediation, or whole-economy safety.
